verdict.rationale: Token2's tools give users direct control to delete data stored on their own security keys — resident credentials/passkeys can be listed, edited, and deleted, biometric templates can be deleted, and factory resets are supported (token2-gh-1, token2-gh-3, token2-docs-7). This covers device-level data deletion but there is no documentation of server-side retention policies, account-level data deletion, or how long any cloud-side telemetry/data is retained. Missing for 10: server-side/account data retention policy documentation, explicit data-deletion request process for any cloud-stored data, independent confirmation of retention practices.
